slides.title: Acquire-Release Semantics
slides.prompt: How do acquire-release memory orders coordinate between threads?
options: A release store in thread A synchronizes with an acquire load in thread B, establishing a happens-before relationship for preceding memory writes
They prevent all hardware instruction reordering completely across all CPU cores
They lock the bus during execution
They force cache flushes to main RAM on every single instruction
slides.correctAnswer: A release store in thread A synchronizes with an acquire load in thread B, establishing a happens-before relationship for preceding memory writes
